notes.title: NEW Little Dungeon Stories Update! - v1.0.7

Hey everyone! Sorry for taking so long to update the game, I was busy with some aspects of life. But during this time I have added lots of cards and more content like a new Effect to the game, I hope you like it!

Let's see what this update contains:

[h2]ːwinter2019happybulbː NEW CONTENT ːwinter2019happybulbː[/h2][list]
[*] Added 4 new potions
[*] Added 4 new weapons
[*] Added 1 new props
[*] Added 2 new NPC
[*] Added 4 new Items
[*] Added 14 new enemies
[*] Added 3 new traps
[*] Added new sounds
[*] More minor adjustments & bug fixes
[/list]

Have a nice weekend and thanks for supporting me! ːwinter2019happyyulː
